More than this, I have long desired to interest the stay-at-homes, our womenfolk, in the gentle art of making pictures of that world wherein they hold the chief place. arxiv-2106-03505.title: Self-supervised Depth Estimation Leveraging Global Perception and Geometric Smoothness Using On-board Videos
arxiv-2106-03505.creator: Shaocheng JIA, Xin PEI, Wei YAO, and S.C. WONG
arxiv-2106-03505.description: Abstract Self-supervised depth estimation has drawn much attention in recent years as it does not require labeled data but image sequences. Moreover, it can be conveniently used in various applications, such as autonomous driving, robotics, realistic navigation, and smart cities. However, extracting global contextual information from images and predicting a geometrically natural depth map remain challenging.

arxiv-2110-13303.title: Negotiating Networks in Oligopoly Markets for Price-Sensitive Products
arxiv-2110-13303.creator: Naman Shukla, Kartik Yellepeddi
arxiv-2110-13303.description: Abstract We present a novel framework to learn functions that estimate decisions of sellers and buyers simultaneously in a oligopoly market for a price-sensitive product. In this setting, the aim of the seller network is to come up with a price for a given context such that the expected revenue is maximised by considering the buyer’s satisfaction as well.

arxiv-2207-11885.title: Distributed Projection-free Algorithm for Constrained Aggregative Optimization
arxiv-2207-11885.creator: Tongyu Wang, Peng Yi
arxiv-2207-11885.description: Abstract In this paper, we focus on solving a distributed convex aggregative optimization problem in a network, where each agent has its own cost function which depends not only on its own decision variables but also on the aggregated function of all agents’ decision variables. The decision variable is constrained within a feasible set.

arxiv-2404-11611.title: Biosignatures from pre-oxygen photosynthesising life on TRAPPIST-1e
arxiv-2404-11611.creator: Jake K. Eager-Nash, Stuart J. Daines, James W. McDermott, Peter Andrews, Lucy A. Grain, James Bishop, Aaron A. Rogers, Jack W. G. Smith, Chadiga Khalek, Thomas J. Boxer, Mei Ting Mak, Robert J. Ridgway, Eric Hébrard, F. Hugo Lambert, Timothy M. Lenton, and Nathan J. Mayne

Smith, Chadiga Khalek, Thomas J. Boxer, Mei Ting Mak, Robert J. Ridgway, Eric Hébrard, F. Hugo Lambert, Timothy M. Lenton, and Nathan J. Mayne. arxiv-2409-12699.title: PromSec : Prompt Optimization for Secure Generation of Functional Source Code with Large Language Models (LLMs)
arxiv-2409-12699.creator: Mahmoud Nazzal, Issa Khalil, Abdallah Khreishah, NhatHai Phan
arxiv-2409-12699.description: Abstract . The capability of generating high-quality source code using large language models (LLMs) reduces software development time and costs. However, recent literature and our empirical investigation in this work show that while LLMs can generate functioning code, they inherently tend to introduce security vulnerabilities, limiting their potential.

arxiv-2410-16231.title: A Quantum Optimization Algorithm for Optimal Electric Vehicle Charging Station Placement for Intercity Trips
arxiv-2410-16231.creator: Tina Radvand, Alireza Talebpour (Corresponding Author), Homa Khosravian
arxiv-2410-16231.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Tina Radvand, Alireza Talebpour (Corresponding Author), Homa Khosravian. Electric vehicles (EVs) play a significant role in enhancing the sustainability of transportation systems. However, their widespread adoption is hindered by inadequate public charging infrastructure, particularly to support long-distance travel. Identifying optimal charging station locations in large transportation networks presents a well-known NP-hard combinatorial optimization problem, as the search space grows exponentially with the number of potential charging station locations.

arxiv-2512-04235.title: A Benchmark Study of Classical and Dual Polynomial Regression (DPR)-Based Probability Density Estimation Techniques
arxiv-2512-04235.creator: Shantanu Sarkar, Mousumi Sinha, Dexter Cahoy
arxiv-2512-04235.description: Abstract The probability density function (PDF) plays a central role in statistical and machine learning modeling. Real-world data often deviates from Gaussian assumptions, exhibiting skewness and exponential decay. To evaluate how well different density estimation methods capture such irregularities, we generated six unimodal datasets from diverse distributions that reflect real-world anomalies.

arxiv-2602-07018.title: The Extremity Premium
arxiv-2602-07018.creator: Sentiment Regimes and Adverse Selection in Cryptocurrency Markets
arxiv-2602-07018.description: Abstract Using the Crypto Fear & Greed Index and Bitcoin daily data, we document that sentiment extremity predicts excess uncertainty beyond realized volatility. Extreme fear and extreme greed regimes exhibit significantly higher spreads than neutral periods—a phenomenon we term the “extremity premium.

pmc-10599528.creator: Devki D. Sukhtankar, Juan José Fung, Mi-na Kim, Thomas Cayton, Valerie Chiou, Niña G. Caculitan, Piotr Zalicki, Sujeong Kim, Yoonjung Jo, SoHui Kim, Jae Min Lee, Junhee Choi, SeongGyeong Mun, Ashley Chin, Yongdae Jang, Ji Yeong Lee, Gowoon Kim, Eun Hee Kim, Won-Ki Huh, Jae-Yeon Jeong, Dong-Seung See
pmc-10599528.description: Autologous Stem Cell Transplant (ASCT) is increasingly used to treat hematological malignancies. A key requisite for ASCT is mobilization of hematopoietic stem cells into peripheral blood, where they are collected by apheresis and stored for later transplantation. However, success is often hindered by poor mobilization due to factors including prior treatments.

pmc-10641490.title: Metabolomic, photoprotective, and photosynthetic acclimatory responses to post‐flowering drought in sorghum
pmc-10641490.creator: Christopher R Baker, Dhruv Patel‐Tupper, Benjamin J Cole, Lindsey G Ching, Oliver Dautermann, Armen C Kelikian, Cayci Allison, Julie Pedraza, Julie Sievert, Aivett Bilbao, Joon‐Yong Lee, Young‐Mo Kim, Jennifer E Kyle, Kent J Bloodsworth, Vanessa Paurus, Kim K Hixson, Robert Hutmacher, Jeffery Dahlbe
pmc-10641490.description: Climate change is globally affecting rainfall patterns, necessitating the improvement of drought tolerance in crops. Sorghum bicolor is a relatively drought‐tolerant cereal. Functional stay‐green sorghum genotypes can maintain green leaf area and efficient grain filling during terminal post‐flowering water deprivation, a period of ~10 weeks.

pmc-10738505.title: RELATIONSHIPS BETWEEN DISTRESS AND NEIGHBORHOOD CHARACTERISTICS FOR MEXICAN AMERICAN CAREGIVERS
pmc-10738505.creator: Florence Johnson, Stipica Mudrazija, Sheria Robinson-Lane, Shekinah Fashaw-Walters, Phillip Cantu
pmc-10738505.description: Previous study demonstrates that caring for older relatives with physical or cognitive disability can increase caregiver stress—particularly if neuropsychiatric symptoms are present. The literature suggests that community features such as the percentage of immigrants may improve Mexican-American caregivers’ mental health.

pmc-11343847.title: MAPLES-DR: MESSIDOR Anatomical and Pathological Labels for Explainable Screening of Diabetic Retinopathy
pmc-11343847.creator: Gabriel Lepetit-Aimon, Clément Playout, Marie Carole Boucher, Renaud Duval, Michael H Brent, Farida Cheriet
pmc-11343847.description: Reliable automatic diagnosis of Diabetic Retinopathy (DR) and Macular Edema (ME) is an invaluable asset in improving the rate of monitored patients among at-risk populations and in enabling earlier treatments before the pathology progresses and threatens vision. However, the explainability of screening models is still an open question, and specifically designed datasets are required to support the research.

pmc-12429258.title: Skin Microbiome Shifts in Various Dermatological Conditions
pmc-12429258.creator: Conan H. Lee, Mildred Min, Sami S. Jin, Raja K. Sivamani
pmc-12429258.description: Background/Objectives: The human skin provides a protective barrier composed of bacteria, fungi, viruses, and archaea that prevents the invasion of harmful organisms. Recent advancements in genomic sequencing have allowed for greater accuracy of species detection. This review aims to summarize the most up-to-date skin microbiome shifts in various dermatological diseases.

pmc-12498377.title: Cortical dysfunction and impulsivity in non-suicidal self-injury: a multimodal study using TMS-EEG and fNIRS
pmc-12498377.creator: Bolin Tan, Chunnan Tong, Peng Xie, Linfei Shou, Yue Ning, Lirong Hu, Tianyi Yuan
pmc-12498377.description: ObjectivesThis study aimed to investigate the cortical excitability differences between adolescents with NSSI and healthy controls using concurrent TMS-EEG and fNIRS.MethodsFifty-three participants aged 12–18 years were recruited, including 27 with NSSI and 26 healthy controls, matched for age. Independent samples t-tests were used to compare groups on the Adolescent Non-Suicidal Self-Injury Assessment Questionnaire (ANSAQ) and Suicidal Ideation Scale (SIOSS).

pmc-12598969.title: Palliative care and end-of-life quality indicators in critical patients in ICU: systematic review protocol
pmc-12598969.creator: Heru Suwardianto, Christantie Effendy, Sri Setiyarini
pmc-12598969.description: AbstractIntroductionPalliative and end-of-life care in the intensive care unit (ICU) is crucial for improving the quality of life of critically ill patients. However, no consensus exists on the most effective quality indicators (QIs) for assessing this care. This systematic review aims to identify and analyse the characteristics of QIs used in palliative and end-of-life care for ICU patients.

pmc-12643498.title: Mitochondrial metabolic rewiring sensitizes mTORC1 inhibitor persister cells to cuproptosis
pmc-12643498.creator: Heng Du, Heng-Jia Liu, Magdalena Losko, Yu Chi Yang, Min Yuan, Elizabeth P. Henske, John M. Asara, Mallika Singh, David J. Kwiatkowski
pmc-12643498.description: Therapeutics blocking PI3K/mTOR complex 1 (mTORC1) are commonly used for tumor treatment, and at times achieve major responses, yet minimal residual disease (MRD) persists, leading to tumor relapse. We developed multiple MRD models both in vitro (rapamycin persistent, RP) and in vivo after mTORC1 inhibition.

pmc-12690704.title: PDNO-24 DIAGNOSTIC ASPECTS OF CHILDHOOD BRAIN TUMORS AT THE BINGERVILLE MOTHER AND CHILD HOSPITAL FROM 2018 TO 2023.
pmc-12690704.creator: Atteby Jean-Jacques Yao, Joseph Diarra
pmc-12690704.description: IntroductionChildhood brain tumors (CBT) are the most common pediatric solid tumors in the West. Their incidence is estimated at 2.5 cases/100,000 inhabitants/year. If their diagnosis has been revolutionized in recent years by medical imaging, TCE continues to pose three types of problems : diagnostic delay, access to treatment and management of after-effects.

pmc-13257133.title: lnc015013-CsMYB30-CsJAZ4/6 Module Co-Regulates JA Synthesis and Enhances Cold Hardiness in Tea Plants
pmc-13257133.creator: Pingping Li, Zhaolan Han, Wei Huang, Huan Zhang, Xujun Zhu, Jie Jiang, Wanping Fang, Yuanchun Ma
pmc-13257133.description: Tea plants (Camellia sinensis) suffer growth limitations under cold stress. Jasmonic acid (JA) and long non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs) are involved in stress responses, yet how lncRNAs regulate JA-mediated cold tolerance remains unclear. Here, we identified an lncRNA, lnc015013, whose silencing compromised cold tolerance in tea plants, a phenotype rescued by exogenous methyl jasmonate (MeJA).

pmc-13440236.title: Long-term follow-up results of anti-BCMA CAR-T cell therapy combined with autologous hematopoietic stem cell transplantation in relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma with extramedullary disease
pmc-13440236.creator: Xin Li, Can Liu, Siyan Niu, Ru Li, Shuquan Gao, Rui Cui, Jia Wang, Yao Qi, Jingyi Li, Qi Deng
pmc-13440236.description: BackgroundRelapsed/refractory multiple myeloma (R/R MM) with extramedullary disease (EMD) has a poor prognosis. Responses to current therapies, including autologous hematopoietic stem cell transplantation (auto-HSCT) and chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T-cell therapy, remain unsatisfactory or show frequent early progression despite an initial response. In this study, we aimed to investigate the efficacy of a therapeutic approach combining CAR T-therapy with auto-HSCT.
